result_1_compression_bound.statement: E*(phi) <= (N - c)/N for any feature map with c cells on N instances
result_1_compression_bound.reading: The realized cell structure confined the floor to [0, 37/1146] before any label was read. Floor 0 is therefore at most this far from the value the cell structure alone would force.

result_2_structure_free_null.question: Given the exact realized cells and class balance, how often does a random relabelling also attain floor 0?
result_2_structure_free_null.reading: Low probability means floor 0 is NOT explained by cell sizes alone and the labels really are aligned with the feature partition. High probability would mean the conversion is an artifact of near-injectivity.

witness_structure_free_null.reading: the witness map is far from injective, so attaining floor 0 with it is overwhelming evidence of genuine structure rather than memorization

result_3_separator_complexity.reading: k* is the minimum number of frozen features whose projection still attains floor 0. Small k* means a genuine low-order sufficient vocabulary exists; k* close to the full 127 would quantify the memorization concern.
